question: The river that is known as Jamuna in Bangladesh is called ______ in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The river known as **Jamuna** in Bangladesh is called the **Brahmaputra** in India.
 
• The Brahmaputra is one of the major rivers of the world, originating from the Angsi Glacier in Tibet, flowing through India and Bangladesh.
 
• In India, it flows through the states of Arunachal Pradesh and Assam before entering Bangladesh.
